# Woodex Interior

> Woodex Interior is an integrated interior design-and-build studio based in Lahore, Pakistan, with studios in Gulberg III Lahore, Clifton Karachi, and F-7 Islamabad. It takes a project from brief through design, 3D visualization, drawings and BOQ, execution, joinery and handover — one team from concept to completion.

## Facts

- Brand: Woodex Interior
- Master line: DRAWN. THEN BUILT.
- Promise: WE TURN IDEAS INTO SPACES.
- Process: Discover → Design → Visualize → Plan (budget + BOQ) → Build → Install → Deliver
- Proof: 500+ projects · founder ~20 years · execution team 10+ years · ISO 9001
- Named client: Wellstar (Pharmacy → Cosmetics → Mini Hospital, DHA Lahore). All other portfolio work is labelled a study.
- WhatsApp: +92 322 4000768 · Call: +92 336 2259477 · Email: studio@woodex.interior
- Desk: LG 90 Link Road, Model Town, Lahore, Pakistan · 10:00–8:30
